description: One case of the conformance corpus: a scenario every SDK's driver is put through, a JSON file of conformance/sdk/wire, conformance/sdk/live or conformance/worker/cases named by the case. What the client is asked to do, what the backend does around it, and the transcript a conforming client produces. conformance/sdk/README.md explains each step; the reader reads every file of the corpus through this schema.

about.description: What the case holds a client to, in a sentence.

source.description: Where the protocol or the spec states it.

planes.description: The signal planes the case runs on. Absent, it runs on both.

tier.description: A live case's tier: `fleet`, what every SDK with a live layer does, or `parity`, what one that implements all of CACHE-SEMANTICS does.

telemetry.description: Run the client exporting to an OTLP receiver, and once it has exited hold what it exported to specs/src/sdk-telemetry/telemetry.json. A worker case also holds the worker to a trace of its own for each job it ran (conformance/worker/README.md).
